name: IKKA Holdings (Cayman) Limited
summary: IKKA Holdings (Cayman) Limited engages in manufacturing, selling, importing, and exporting of plastic automotive parts and modules in Japan, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, and internationally. The company offers precision plastic injection molded parts for automobiles and electric vehicles; molded products; gears; business machine parts; and residential related equipment parts and other products. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in George Town, the Cayman Islands.
